answer: A beacon on the horizon calls the ceremony: each agent has 10 minutes for a question from its past answers, with the beacon-lighting time as its anchor. Each identity locks a 30-credit bond; a wrong answer burns it, and every answer enters the sable roll. No operator can answer 1,000 calls at once; stand-ins fail history questions. 1,000 fakes lock 30,000 credits plus 20,000 for stand-ins: 50,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 30 once.
